The program was rejected for the token `input`. It only appears in the comments ("Input pair", "input pair"), so I renamed those comments to "diff pair". The sizing and topology are unchanged and have not been simulated yet. Hand estimates suggest everything is met except gain, which is borderline:

| Spec | Estimate | Required |
|---|---|---|
| Unity-gain bandwidth | about 19 MHz | ≥ 10 MHz |
| Phase margin | about 60–65° | ≥ 60° |
| Slew rate | about 17 V/µs | ≥ 10 MV/s |
| Power | about 0.6 mW | ≤ 1 mW |
| DC gain | borderline | ≥ 70 dB |

PARAMS = {
    "gmid1": (14, 10, 18),        # diff pair efficiency
    "L1":    (1.0, 0.5, 2.0),     # diff pair L (gain)
    "Itail": (60e-6, 40e-6, 100e-6),
    "Lp":    (1.0, 0.5, 2.0),     # PMOS mirror load L
    "gmid7": (10, 7, 14),         # 2nd-stage PMOS
    "L7":    (0.5, 0.3, 1.0),
    "I7":    (260e-6, 150e-6, 380e-6),
    "Ln":    (2.0, 1.0, 3.0),     # NMOS current-source L
    "Cc":    (3.5e-12, 2e-12, 6e-12),
    "rz_k":  (1.8, 1.0, 4.0),     # Rz = rz_k / gm7
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    cl = spec.get("cl", 10e-12)
    iref = spec.get("iref", 10e-6)
    vdd = 1.8
    gmid_n = 12.0
    It, I7, Cc = p["Itail"], p["I7"], p["Cc"]
    I1 = It / 2

    # Diff pair: VCM 0.9 V, tail node ~0.2 V, so the pair has vsb ~0.2 V.
    m1 = lut.size("n", p["gmid1"], p["L1"], I1, vds=0.6, vsb=0.2)
    # PMOS mirror load
    m3 = lut.size("p", 8, p["Lp"], I1, vds=1.0)
    # 2nd stage PMOS common source
    m7 = lut.size("p", p["gmid7"], p["L7"], I7, vds=0.9)
    # NMOS bias: diode, tail and output current-source load (same L and gm/Id).
    mb = lut.size("n", gmid_n, p["Ln"], iref, vds=0.7)
    mt = lut.size("n", gmid_n, p["Ln"], It, vds=0.2)
    m8 = lut.size("n", gmid_n, p["Ln"], I7, vds=0.9)

    Rz = p["rz_k"] / m7.gm

    n = Netlist("vinp vinn vout vdd vss ibias")
    n.dev("MB", "ibias", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mb)
    n.dev("MT", "tail", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mt)
    n.dev("M1", "d1", "vinn", "tail", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("M2", "o1", "vinp", "tail", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("M3", "d1", "d1", "vdd", "vdd", m3)
    n.dev("M4", "o1", "d1", "vdd", "vdd", m3)
    n.dev("M7", "vout", "o1", "vdd", "vdd", m7)
    n.dev("M8", "vout", "ibias", "vss", "vss", m8)
    n.R("RZ", "o1", "cz", Rz)
    n.C("CC", "cz", "vout", Cc)

    gm1 = m1.gm
    A1 = gm1 / (m1.gds + m3.gds)
    A2 = m7.gm / (m7.gds + m8.gds)
    gain_db = db(A1 * A2)
    C1 = m7.cgg + m3.cdd + m1.cdd
    ugbw = gm1 / (2 * PI * Cc)
    p2 = m7.gm * Cc / (C1 * cl + Cc * (C1 + cl)) / (2 * PI)
    pm_mirror = m3.gm / (2 * m3.cgg) / (2 * PI)
    den = (1.0 / m7.gm - Rz)
    z = abs(1.0 / (2 * PI * Cc * den)) if abs(den) > 1e-12 else 1e15
    zsign = 1 if den < 0 else -1
    pm = 90 - math.degrees(math.atan(ugbw / p2)) \
            - math.degrees(math.atan(ugbw / pm_mirror)) \
            + zsign * math.degrees(math.atan(ugbw / z))
    slew = min(It / Cc, I7 / (cl + Cc))
    power = vdd * (iref + It + I7)
    swing = vdd - m7.vdsat - m8.vdsat - 0.1
    return n, {"gain_db": gain_db, "ugbw": ugbw, "pm": pm, "slew": slew,
               "power": power, "swing": swing}
